title: Device telemetry
description: One reading of one device: a timestamp and a map of tag name to value. Published on `<prefix>/devices/{deviceId}/data` by a gateway, or on `tenants/{tenantId}/devices/{deviceId}/data` by a directly connected device. Also the body shape (after normalisation) of the HTTP webhook ingest, which validates with this same schema. The backend validates with Ajv `removeAdditional: true`: an undeclared top-level key is SILENTLY DROPPED, not rejected, so do not put anything here that is not declared below.

ts.description: When the values were read, in Unix epoch MILLISECONDS (not seconds). Stamped by the publisher at read time, not at publish time.

values.description: Tag name -> value. The key is the tag's canonical stream key (for a Modbus tag its subtype, for a bus sensor its name). At least one entry.

q.description: Data quality for the whole message. Omitted means `good`.

seq.description: Optional per-device message counter. Recorded as provenance on the events a message causes (Event.cause.seq), so the same seq under two trace ids reveals one message processed twice.
